Name: (CP)(MMAP)WhereWindsMeet Kaifeng
Author: umganil
Description:
Finally！！This is the second installment of the wherewindsmeet series:Kaifeng.
For players who are not interested in wherewindsmeet, you can use it as an ordinary ancient Chinese style furniture package.
------------------------------- Suggestions for use:--------------------------------------------------------

[list]
[*]The furniture catalog is available for purchase from Robin.
[*]This is the Kaifeng chapter of the Yanyun series, which mainly features interior furniture with the theme of the prosperity and splendor of Kaifeng, including screens, gauze curtains, hanging paintings and various Chinese perspectives. There are also some wallpapers (some wallpapers that look different in style are entirely my personal aesthetic habit;v;).
[*]It is strongly recommended to use with Happy Home Designer (19675) and Precision Furniture ( 23488)!
[*]This version doesn't have many special features, but still requires MMAP as a prerequisite to ensure that arches and veils pass correctly.
[*]For players who don’t play WhereWindsMeet, you can use this as ordinary antique style furniture.
[*]I18n files are used. If you want to translate, feel free to do so.！
[/list]
If you like this mod, please give me a thumbs up, which is  important to me;v;
